items.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says

sentences.en: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says.
sentences.zh: 慈善机构称，数百万美元的埃博拉防治资金下落不明，工作人员未领到工资，而病毒仍在蔓延。

sentences.en: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
sentences.zh: 无国界医生组织警告称，医护人员领不到工资，缺乏适当培训，并面临基本物资短缺的困境。

items.title: NAZA: how and where to watch the Guardian’s acclaimed Gaza documentary

sentences.en: NAZA: how and where to watch the Guardian’s acclaimed Gaza documentary.
sentences.zh: NAZA：《卫报》广受好评的加沙纪录片：如何观看以及在哪里观看。

sentences.en: Film features testimony from 24 Israeli officials involved in surveillance and remote killing of Palestinian civilians • NAZA is in cinemas worldwide and will screen for free on the Guardian’s website from early December.
sentences.zh: 这部纪录片收录了24名参与监视和远程杀害巴勒斯坦平民的以色列官员的证词•《NAZA》正在全球各地的电影院上映，并将于12月初在《卫报》网站上免费放映。

sentences.en: Sign up here to be the first to watch it Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 在此处注册，成为首批观看者继续阅读……

sentences.zh: 由Warby Parker和Gentle Monster设计，三星负责工程设计的谷歌智能眼镜现已开放预订。

items.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang

sentences.en: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚针对海湾帮的空袭造成八人死亡。

sentences.en: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚总统表示，被杀者中有一名涉嫌为帮派头目的人，他被认为是“重点打击对象”。

items.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza cleared of using AI to write prize-winning story

sentences.en: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza cleared of using AI to write prize-winning story.
sentences.zh: 津巴布韦作家辛巴拉舍·昆迪泽扎（Simbarashe Kundizeza）被证实未曾使用人工智能撰写获奖小说。

sentences.en: After a month-long investigation it was concluded that Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter, which won the £10,000 Caine prize, was ‘human-written’ The Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza has been cleared of using AI to write a prize-winning short story, after the prestigious Caine prize for African writers concluded that his entry was “human-written” after a month-long investigation.
sentences.zh: 经过为期一个月的调查，得出的结论是，昆迪泽扎获得1万英镑凯恩奖的小说《蓝战士》是“人类撰写的”。津巴布韦作家辛巴拉舍·昆迪泽扎（Simbarashe Kundizeza）被认定没有使用人工智能撰写获奖短篇小说，因为针对非洲作家的著名凯恩奖经过为期一个月的调查后得出结论，他的参赛作品是“人类撰写的”。

sentences.en: Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter , which charts the declining fortunes of a family after the father invests in fish tanks, was announced as the winner of the £10,000 prize on 6 October.
sentences.zh: 10月6日，昆迪泽扎的小说《蓝战士》（The Blue Fighter）被宣布为1万英镑奖金的获奖作品。这部小说讲述了一个家庭在父亲投资鱼缸后家道中落的故事。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

sentences.zh: 獲得詳細資料

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century

sentences.en: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century.
sentences.zh: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆（Scott Colom）成为密西西比州自19世纪以来的首位黑人参议员，创造了历史。

sentences.en: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 在两年前特朗普以22个百分点的优势赢得的这个州，科洛姆的胜利延续了民主党在参议院的一系列胜利。

items.title: Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza kills surgeon and five others

sentences.en: Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza kills surgeon and five others.
sentences.zh: 以色列对加沙纳赛尔医院的空袭造成一名外科医生和其他五人死亡。

sentences.en: Hospital director says 28 wounded in attack on one of few remaining medical facilities in the strip An Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in southern Gaza killed six people, including a surgeon and a disabled man, and wounded 28 others, according to the hospital director.
sentences.zh: 医院院长称，加沙地带仅存的几家医疗机构之一遭到袭击，造成28人受伤。据医院院长称，以色列对加沙南部纳赛尔医院的空袭造成6人死亡，其中包括一名外科医生和一名残疾人，另有28人受伤。

sentences.en: The Israeli military carried out the attack on the hospital, in Khan Younis, early on Thursday saying in a statement it had struck a Hamas commander and other fighters there, without providing evidence.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方于周四凌晨对汗尤尼斯的一家医院发动了袭击，并在一份声明中称，他们袭击了该处的一名哈马斯指挥官和其他战斗人员，但未提供证据。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Haiti: More than 1,000 killed between July and September, UN report reveals

sentences.en: Haiti: More than 1,000 killed between July and September, UN report reveals.
sentences.zh: 海地：联合国报告显示，7月至9月期间有1000多人丧生。

sentences.en: More than 1,000 people were killed in Haiti during the third quarter of this year, as armed gangs continue to terrorize the population in the capital Port-au-Prince and beyond, the UN team in the island nation, said in its latest human rights report.
sentences.zh: 联合国驻海地小组在其最新的人权报告中表示，今年第三季度，海地有1000多人丧生，因为武装团伙继续在首都太子港及其他地区对民众实施恐怖活动。

items.title: Kenya begins countdown towards end of Ebola after last patient discharged

sentences.en: Kenya begins countdown towards end of Ebola after last patient discharged.
sentences.zh: 随着最后一例患者出院，肯尼亚开始进入埃博拉疫情结束的倒计时。

sentences.en: Kenya began a 42-day countdown to the end of its Ebola outbreak on Thursday, a day after the last patient being treated for the disease went home and 11 people were released from quarantine.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚于周四开始为期42天的埃博拉疫情结束倒计时，此前一天，最后一名接受埃博拉病毒治疗的患者出院回家，11人解除隔离。

items.title: COP31: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action

sentences.en: COP31: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action.
sentences.zh: COP31：随着领导人面临采取行动的要求，城市在气候议程中占据越来越重要的地位。

sentences.en: From flooded homes to melting Himalayan glaciers, the human cost of climate change took centre stage at COP31 on Thursday, as world leaders turned their attention to protecting cities and vulnerable communities, while activists challenged governments to do more.
sentences.zh: 从被洪水淹没的房屋到正在融化的喜马拉雅冰川，气候变化造成的人类代价在周四的COP31会议上成为焦点。世界各国领导人将注意力转向保护城市和弱势群体，而活动人士则敦促各国政府采取更多行动。

items.title: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes

sentences.en: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes.
sentences.zh: 新平台旨在在灾害发生前就让资金流动起来。

sentences.en: UN agencies on Thursday launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, that aims to secure access to more than $3 billion in risk financing to protect 75 million people and their livelihoods from climate shocks and natural hazards by 2030.
sentences.zh: 联合国各机构周四在土耳其安塔利亚举行的第三十一届缔约方大会（COP31）上启动了一个联合平台，旨在到2030年确保获得超过30亿美元的风险融资，以保护7500万人及其生计免受气候冲击和自然灾害的影响。

items.title: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis

sentences.en: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis.
sentences.zh: 世界粮食计划署负责人警告称，随着资金削减加剧饥饿危机，援助是苏丹数百万人的“唯一希望”。

sentences.en: The World Food Programme’s (WFP) new Executive Director has warned that funding cuts are worsening Sudan’s hunger crisis following his first field mission to the country, where he met families displaced by conflict and struggling to feed their children.
sentences.zh: 世界粮食计划署（WFP）新任执行主任在首次访问苏丹后发出警告，称资金削减正在加剧该国的饥饿危机。他在访问期间会见了因冲突而流离失所、正为子女的口粮而苦苦挣扎的家庭。

items.title: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital

sentences.en: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital.
sentences.zh: 以色列空袭加沙的纳赛尔医院，造成六人死亡。

sentences.en: An Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital on Wednesday night killed six people, injured 27 others and caused extensive damage.
sentences.zh: 周三晚，以色列对加沙的纳赛尔医院发动空袭，造成6人死亡，27人受伤，并造成大范围破坏。

items.title: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas

sentences.en: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas.
sentences.zh: 在喜马拉雅山脉东部发现了五种新的微型蛙类。

sentences.en: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.
sentences.zh: 科学家表示，随着喜马拉雅山的隆起和亚洲季风的形成，青蛙也随之进化。

items.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying

sentences.en: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying.
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明执政联盟正在分崩离析，印尼副总统辞职。

sentences.en: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
sentences.zh: 这一消息是在普拉博沃总统面临动荡之际传出的，他与前任佐科·维多多之间的裂痕日益加深。

items.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning

sentences.en: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning.
sentences.zh: 在乌干达一所学校疑似发生中毒事件导致四名女生死亡后，对橙子进行了调查。

sentences.en: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
sentences.zh: 这些女生在吃了同学带的橙子后开始呕吐，警方正前往她们的家乡。

items.title: Thursday briefing: What we do (and don’t) know about Alice Huang and the Nvidia affair

sentences.en: Thursday briefing: What we do (and don’t) know about Alice Huang and the Nvidia affair.
sentences.zh: 周四简报：关于黄仁勋和英伟达事件，我们所知（和未知）的信息。

sentences.en: In today’s newsletter: US intelligence reportedly believes the former tech executive was recruited by Beijing, raising questions about the security of the AI industry and Trump’s close ties to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang Good morning.
sentences.zh: 今日要闻：据报道，美国情报部门认为这位前科技公司高管被北京招募，这引发了人们对人工智能行业安全以及特朗普与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋密切关系问题的关注。早上好！

sentences.en: Espionage is supposed to be a secretive business, and spies are supposed to be virtually invisible.
sentences.zh: 间谍活动理应是秘密进行的，间谍理应几乎隐身于无形。

sentences.en: That hasn’t been the case for Alice Huang, the mysterious Shanghai executive who formed a romantic relationship with Jensen Huang, the founder of Nvidia, one of America’s most powerful tech companies.
sentences.zh: 对于神秘的上海高管Alice Huang来说，情况并非如此。她与美国最具实力的科技公司之一Nvidia的创始人Jensen Huang建立了浪漫关系。

sentences.en: Many questions have arisen since it emerged that US intelligence believes that Huang (no relation of Jensen’s) is an asset recruited by the Chinese intelligence services to spy on behalf of Beijing.
sentences.zh: 自美国情报部门认为黄（与Jensen无亲属关系）是中国情报部门招募的间谍，为北京进行间谍活动以来，引发了许多问题。

sentences.en: This morning’s newsletter explains what we know about the story, and what it tells us about the effectiveness of Chinese espionage.
sentences.zh: 今日晨报介绍了我们对该事件的了解，以及它向我们揭示了中国间谍活动的有效性。

sentences.en: That’s after the headlines.
sentences.zh: 这是头条新闻之后的内容。

sentences.en: UK | Ministers are considering changing the law to force the entertainment industry to better protect women and children in the wake of the revelations over David Walliams and the conviction of Russell Brand.
sentences.zh: 英国 | 在曝出大卫·沃廉姆斯（David Walliams）丑闻以及拉塞尔·布兰德（Russell Brand）被定罪后，英国政府部长正在考虑修改法律，以迫使娱乐行业更好地保护妇女和儿童。

sentences.en: Climate | The UK government has appointed the world’s first special representative for climate security, in the strongest sign yet of fears that climate breakdown will bring chaos to the country.
sentences.zh: 气候 | 英国政府任命了全球首位气候安全特别代表，这是迄今为止最强有力的迹象，表明人们担心气候崩溃将给该国带来混乱。

sentences.en: US midterms | Democrat Scott Colom has become the first Black senator in Mississippi to be elected since Reconstruction, in a stunning upset after more than a week of vote counting in one of the country’s most reliably red states.
sentences.zh: 美国中期选举 | 在美国最稳固的共和党州之一，经过一周多的计票，民主党人斯科特·科洛姆（Scott Colom）在一次令人震惊的逆转中当选，成为自重建时期以来密西西比州首位当选的黑人参议员。

sentences.en: Europe | Millions of people across Spain have joined the country’s first general strike in 14 years , setting up picket lines to protest against soaring housing prices before an election in which the far right could be catapulted into power.
sentences.zh: 欧洲 | 西班牙各地数百万人参加了该国14年来的首次大罢工，在极右翼可能借此上台的选举之前，他们筑起警戒线，抗议房价飙升。

sentences.en: Technology | Police officers risk arresting innocent people , especially from ethnic minorities, if they treat inaccurate facial recognition data as evidence, an official report has found.
sentences.zh: 科技 | 一份官方报告指出，如果将不准确的面部识别数据作为证据，警察就有可能逮捕无辜者，尤其是少数族裔。

items.title: Oil slicks seen from space: the devastating impact of boat strikes on fragile Gulf ecosystems

sentences.en: Oil slicks seen from space: the devastating impact of boat strikes on fragile Gulf ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 从太空中看到的浮油：船只撞击对脆弱的海湾生态系统造成的破坏性影响。

sentences.en: Since the US war on Iran began in February, there have been hundreds of oil spills, posing a ‘generational’ threat to wildlife The vast, dark slicks in the strait of Hormuz are visible from space.
sentences.zh: 自2月美国对伊朗发动战争以来，已发生数百起漏油事件，对野生动物构成“代际”威胁。霍尔木兹海峡的大片黑色油污从太空中都清晰可见。

sentences.en: Throughout October, oil tankers were struck by missiles or sea mines in the waterway and spilled crude into the sea.
sentences.zh: 整个10月份，油轮在水道中被导弹或水雷击中，原油泄漏入海。

sentences.en: The pollution has spread across the Gulf, contaminating coastlines and threatening to cause lasting damage to marine ecosystems that are home to dolphins, sea turtles and countless species of fish.
sentences.zh: 污染已蔓延至整个海湾，污染了海岸线，并有可能对海豚、海龟和无数鱼类栖息的海洋生态系统造成持久性破坏。

sentences.en: Eight months into the war between the US and Iran, one of the world’s busiest oil shipping routes has become a battlefield and the centre of a growing environmental disaster .
sentences.zh: 美伊战争爆发八个月后，世界上最繁忙的石油运输航线之一已成为战场，并成为日益严重的环境灾难的中心。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive

sentences.en: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive.
sentences.zh: 在丛林中失踪六天的澳大利亚少年获救。

sentences.en: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".
sentences.zh: 这位17岁男孩的妈妈开玩笑说，他被“终身禁足”，而且“再也不会离开家了”。

items.title: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies

sentences.en: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学将两颗可能属于奴隶的头骨用于优生学研究后，现已将其归还给巴西。

sentences.en: Remains believed to have belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians repatriated after being flown back by diplomats Two skulls, including that of a man believed to have taken part in Brazil’s greatest slave revolt but whose remains were taken to the United States and used in racist eugenics studies at Harvard University, were repatriated on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 据信属于非洲人或非裔巴西人的遗骸在外交官的护送下被遣返。周三，两具头骨被遣返，其中一具据信属于一名曾参与巴西最大奴隶起义的男子，但他的遗骸被带到美国，用于哈佛大学的种族优生学研究。

sentences.en: The remains had been outside Brazil since the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 这些遗骸自19世纪以来就一直在巴西境外。

sentences.en: One was taken about 190 years ago from Salvador, the capital of the state of Bahia; the other, about 160 years ago, from Rio de Janeiro – and were welcomed back in moving, subdued ceremonies in both cities.
sentences.zh: 其中一具遗骸约190年前从巴伊亚州首府萨尔瓦多被带走；另一具遗骸约160年前从里约热内卢被带走。两座城市都以感人而庄严的仪式欢迎遗骸回归。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike

sentences.en: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike.
sentences.zh: 数千人参加西班牙大罢工后，巴塞罗那爆发冲突。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.
sentences.zh: 该国主要工会号召的这场罢工吸引了数万人参与，抗议对象是住房问题和高昂的生活成本。

items.title: Test your applications against AWS locally with AWS Emulator

sentences.en: Test your applications against AWS locally with AWS Emulator.
sentences.zh: 使用 AWS Emulator 在本地对您的应用程序进行 AWS 测试。

sentences.en: Today we’re announcing AWS Emulator, a local emulator for Amazon Web Services (AWS) that you run on your machine.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布推出AWS Emulator，这是一款用于Amazon Web Services (AWS) 的本地模拟器，您可以在自己的计算机上运行。

sentences.en: The AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) , the AWS SDKs , and your coding agents speak to it over a local HTTPS endpoint using the same AWS APIs they would use in the cloud, from your laptop.
sentences.zh: AWS 命令行界面 (AWS CLI)、AWS SDK 和您的编码代理通过本地 HTTPS 终端节点与其通信，使用的 AWS API 与它们在云中使用的相同，并且是从您的笔记本电脑上使用的。

sentences.en: AWS Emulator has no additional service fee.
sentences.zh: AWS 模拟器不收取额外服务费。

sentences.en: You pay only for AWS resources when you deploy on AWS.
sentences.zh: 您仅需在 AWS 上部署时为 AWS 资源付费。

sentences.en: Its source is on GitHub .
sentences.zh: 其源代码托管在 GitHub 上。

sentences.en: You install it from an RPM or Debian package on Linux, and on macOS and Windows you run it in Docker.
sentences.zh: 您可以在 Linux 上从 RPM 或 Debian 包安装它，在 macOS 和 Windows 上则在 Docker 中运行它。

sentences.en: How it works You install the emulator, start it, and point your tools at the local endpoint.
sentences.zh: 工作原理您安装模拟器，启动模拟器，然后将您的工具指向本地端点。

sentences.en: When AWS Emulator starts, it generates its own credentials, a config file, and a certificate, and writes them to ~/.aws/emulator/9297/ .
sentences.zh: AWS Emulator 启动时，它会生成自己的凭证、配置文件和证书，并将它们写入 ~/.aws/emulator/9297/。

sentences.en: You set environment variables so the AWS SDK talks to your laptop instead of AWS, and your application code stays unchanged.
sentences.zh: 您设置了环境变量，以便 AWS SDK 与您的笔记本电脑而非 AWS 通信，并且您的应用程序代码保持不变。

sentences.en: From there, your existing tests, CLI scripts, and coding agents keep working the way they already do.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，您现有的测试、CLI脚本和编码代理将继续按原样运行。

sentences.en: A unit test that creates an Amazon DynamoDB table, writes an item, and reads it back is the same test, and it runs on your machine without a deployment.
sentences.zh: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表、写入一个项目并将其读回的单元测试是同一项测试，它在您的计算机上运行，无需部署。

items.title: Ex-member of radical Marxist group scales balcony, escapes house arrest in Argentina

sentences.en: Ex-member of radical Marxist group scales balcony, escapes house arrest in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 激进马克思主义团体的前成员攀爬阳台，在阿根廷逃离软禁。

sentences.en: Leonardo Bertulazzi, 74, awaiting extradition to Italy, reportedly used harness to flee custody A 74-year-old former member of Italy ’s radical Marxist group the Red Brigades has escaped from house arrest in Argentina , the country’s security ministry confirmed on Wednesday, after he reportedly hid his ankle monitor inside a tube of pork and lowered himself from a fifth-floor balcony.
sentences.zh: 据报道，74岁的莱昂纳多·贝图拉齐（Leonardo Bertulazzi）正等待被引渡回意大利，他据称使用绳索逃离了软禁。阿根廷安全部周三证实，这位74岁的前意大利激进马克思主义组织“红色旅”成员已从阿根廷的软禁中逃脱。据报道，他将脚踝监测器藏在猪肉管中，然后从五楼的阳台爬下。

sentences.en: Authorities placed Leonardo Bertulazzi under house arrest in Buenos Aires in 2024, prior to his extradition to Italy to serve a 27-year prison sentence.
sentences.zh: 2024年，当局将莱昂纳多·贝图拉齐（Leonardo Bertulazzi）软禁在布宜诺斯艾利斯，随后将其引渡至意大利服27年徒刑。

sentences.en: He had received the sentence in 1987 for joining a subversive association and belonging to an armed group.
sentences.zh: 他因参加颠覆性组织和隶属于武装团体，于1987年被判刑。

items.title: Argentinian lawyer mocks UK’s sovereignty claim in Falklands oil case

sentences.en: Argentinian lawyer mocks UK’s sovereignty claim in Falklands oil case.
sentences.zh: 在福克兰群岛石油案中，阿根廷律师嘲讽英国的主权主张。

sentences.en: Lawyer says Britain wrong to believe in historic doctrine that crown has sovereignty over parts of oceans Britain should not be permitted to act as a 17th-century colonial power treating the waters around the Falkland Islands as a Dominium maris Britannici , Argentina has told an international tribunal.
sentences.zh: 律师表示，英国错误地相信了王室对部分海洋拥有主权的传统主张。阿根廷在国际法庭上表示，不应允许英国像17世纪的殖民强国那样行事，将福克兰群岛（阿根廷称马尔维纳斯群岛）周围的海域视为“大不列颠海域”（Dominium maris Britannici）。

sentences.en: Marcelo Kohen, representing Argentina at a hearing in Hamburg, mocked Britain for apparently believing in the historic doctrine that the British crown has sovereignty over expansive parts of the oceans.
sentences.zh: 马塞洛·科恩（Marcelo Kohen）代表阿根廷出席在汉堡举行的听证会，他嘲笑英国显然相信英国王室对广阔海域拥有主权的这一历史学说。
